name: Globe
label: Globe
description: An orthographic globe with markers and great-circle arcs, rotated by drag, keys, or a slow spin.

props.name: arcs
props.description: The arcs to draw between them. An arc whose endpoint is not in `points` is skipped.

props.name: rotation
props.description:
Controlled view: `[longitude, latitude]` of the centre, in degrees.
Pair with `onRotationChange`. Omit to let the globe own its rotation.

props.name: onRotationChange
props.description: Fires whenever the view changes — drag, keys, or the auto-rotation.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description:
Spin slowly on its own, in degrees per second at the shipped motion
tempo. The speed follows `--motion-duration-orbit`, so a theme that
stretches or shortens its durations slows or quickens the spin with
them. Pauses while the pointer is over the globe or it has focus, and
never runs under `prefers-reduced-motion`. `0` switches it off.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag to rotate, and rotate with the arrow keys (or W, A, S, D) when focused.

props.name: graticuleStep
props.description: Degrees between graticule lines. `0` removes the graticule.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: Draw each point's `label` beside its marker.

props.name: activePointId
props.description: The point to single out: its marker enlarges and its callout renders.

props.name: onPointHover
props.description: Fires as the pointer enters a marker (or it takes focus), and with `null` as it leaves.

props.name: onPointClick
props.description:
Fires when a marker is clicked, or activated with Enter or Space while
focused. Setting it makes the markers real buttons on a non-interactive
globe too.

props.name: renderCallout
props.description:
Renders the annotation for the active (or hovered) point. It is placed
beside the marker in an HTML overlay, so any markup works; MapCallout is
the intended filling. The overlay carries `data-side="left"|"right"` for
which side of the marker it sits on.

props.name: label
props.description:
Accessible name for the globe, e.g. "Listening points across the
network". The point and arc counts are appended for screen readers.

props.name: pointsLabel
props.description: The point count appended to the globe's accessible name, given the count. Defaults to "<count> point" or "<count> points".

props.name: arcsLabel
props.description: The arc count appended to the globe's accessible name, given the count. Defaults to "<count> arc" or "<count> arcs".

props.name: rotateHintLabel
props.description: The pointer and keyboard instructions appended to the accessible name while `interactive`.
props.default: Drag to rotate, or use the arrow keys when focused.

props.name: roleDescription
props.description:
What assistive technology calls the globe in place of its role, applied
whichever role it takes: `application` while `interactive`, `group` when
only `onPointClick` makes the markers buttons, and `img` otherwise.
Defaults to "globe".
